chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ibrahim ibn Miham from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that Ali (peace be upon him) said:
He who immerses himself in mud has shared in the blood of his own soul.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to share in the blood of one's own soul according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) uses the metaphor of 'immersing in mud' to describe deep entanglement in worldly desires or major sins, equating this state with shedding one's own spiritual blood. This reflects the Shia concept of *self-harm* (*darar bi-nafs*), where neglecting one's spiritual purity through excessive attachment to the material world is viewed as a form of self-destruction. The narration serves as a practical warning for believers to maintain detachment (*zuhd*) to preserve the sanctity of the soul.
